name: Lie Algebra (Tangent Plane) Pose Optimization
definition: A gradient-based optimization approach that solves for pose estimation variables ξ in the Lie algebra se(3) (tangent plane) rather than directly on the SE(3) manifold, providing smoother and quicker convergence.
summary: Lie Algebra Pose Optimization estimates camera pose by optimizing in the tangent space of the special Euclidean group, achieving smoother and quicker convergence than direct manifold optimization.
